content: SERVICES AGREEMENT

label: header
content:
Copper Indigo Consulting Ltd
Ref CI/2019/0302 · 2 March 2019

label: text
content: This agreement is made on 2 March 2019 between the parties named below and sets out the terms on which services are supplied.

label: text
content: Supplier: Copper Indigo Consulting Ltd, registered in Scotland, of 14 Academy Street, Inverness, represented by Priya Ashworth, Managing Director.

label: text
content:
Client: Caldwell Marine Supplies Ltd, of B Sandgate, Ayr,
represented by Niamh Caldwell, Finance Director.

label: paragraph_title
content: 1. SERVICES

label: text
content: 1. The Supplier shall provide the bookkeeping, payroll preparation and management reporting services described in Schedule A (the "Services"). $ ^{1} $

label: text
content: 2. The Supplier shall perform the Services with reasonable skill and care and in accordance with good industry practice.

label: text
content: 3. The Client shall give the Supplier timely access to records, staff and premises as reasonably required.

label: paragraph_title
content: 2. FEES AND PAYMENT

label: text
content: 4. The Client shall pay the monthly fee of £1,850 plus VAT at the prevailing rate, invoiced on the first working day of each month. $ ^{2} $

label: text
content: 5. Invoices are payable within 30 days of the invoice date. Late sums carry interest at 4% above the Bank of England base rate.

label: text
content: 6. Expenses are recharged at cost where approved in writing in advance.

label: paragraph_title
content: 3. CONDITIONS TO BE SATISFIED BEFORE THE START DATE

label: text
content: The Services begin on 1 April 2019 once each of the following has been confirmed by the Client:

label: text
content: √ Signed copy of this agreement returned to the Supplier

label: text
content: √ Anti-money-laundering identity checks completed for all directors

label: text
content: √ Read-only access granted to the Client's accounting system

label: text
content: x Opening balances supplied for the year ended 31 December 2018

label: text
content: x Payroll authority letter received from the Client's bank

label: paragraph_title
content: 4. CONFIDENTIALITY AND DATA

label: text
content: 7. Each party shall keep the other's confidential information secret and use it only for the purposes of this agreement.

label: text
content: 8. The Supplier shall process personal data only on the Client's documented instructions and in line with data protection law $ ^{3} $ .

label: text
content: 9. On termination the Supplier shall return or delete the Client's records within 30 days, unless the law requires it to keep them.

label: paragraph_title
content: 5. TERM AND TERMINATION

label: text
content: 10. This agreement runs for an initial term of twelve months and then continues until either party gives three months' written notice.

label: text
content: 11. Either party may end it at once by written notice if the other commits a material breach that is not put right within 14 days of notice.

label: text
content: 12. This agreement is governed by the law of Scotland, and the Scottish courts have exclusive jurisdiction.

label: text
content: Signed for the Supplier: Priya Ashworth Date: 2 March 2019

label: text

content: $ ^{1} $ Schedule A lists the monthly deliverables and their deadlines; the Supplier may vary them only with the Client's consent.

label: footnote
content: $ ^{2} $ The monthly fee is reviewed each April and may rise by no more than the Consumer Prices Index over the preceding year.

label: footnote
content: $ ^{3} $The data processing terms are set out in Schedule C and form part of this agreement.
